# Laundry Express

> Professional doorstep laundry pickup, 24-hour wash and fold service, and return delivery in Lake in the Hills, IL, USA and surrounding McHenry and Kane County communities.

Laundry Express provides doorstep wash-and-fold laundry service with individual cycle wash, gentle dry, crisp folding, and guaranteed 24-hour return delivery. Based in Lake in the Hills, IL, USA, customers can select by-the-bag (13-gallon capacity), by-the-pound (lbs), or prepaid packages with eco-friendly cold water care and custom detergent formulations.

## Core Capabilities & Laundry Services

- **Wash and Fold Doorstep Pickup & Delivery**: Full-service residential and commercial laundry with guaranteed 24-hour turnaround.
- **By-the-Bag Wash & Fold (13-Gallon Capacity)**: Standard laundry volume (~15–20 lbs / 2 loads) per 13-gallon bag with flat pricing.
- **Weighed Laundry by the Pound (lbs)**: Ideal for everyday apparel, sheets, bed linens, towels, and bulk laundry.
- **Individual Washer & Dryer Cycles**: Strictly dedicated equipment per client order (zero laundry co-mingling or cross-contamination).
- **Eco-Friendly Fabric Care**: Cold-water wash cycles preserving garment color and fiber integrity, paired with gentle tumble drying.
- **Custom Detergent Bar**: Hypoallergenic plant-based formulas, Free & Clear, Tide, Gain, and Persil options.
- **Contactless Doorstep Protocol**: Away-from-home secure pickup and return with driver delivery verification.
- **100% Satisfaction Guarantee**: Free prompt re-wash on any order that does not meet pristine freshness standards.
